details: Beginning search for tensix_all_reduce example and two_phase_reduce_mcast pattern

Read tensix_all_reduce program_descriptor: found _TWO_PHASE_KERNEL (lines 505-590), _REDUCE_ROOT_KERNEL (436-502), _MCAST_ALL_GATHER_KERNEL (384-433), _create_two_phase_descriptor (1009-1064). Master.md two-phase guidance lines 255-267.

Read mcast_pipe.hpp: SenderPipe/ReceiverPipe handshake. data_ready=SEM_MCAST_READY flag, consumer_ready=SEM_MCAST_CONSUMED counter, PRE_HANDSHAKE default true. Confirmed two-phase semaphore protocol. Ready to report.

DEST-reuse bcast fusion investigation for rms_norm pass2. compute_kernel_api binary_dest_reuse_tiles (eltwise_binary.h:289) hardcodes BroadcastType::NONE in BOTH unpack (llk_unpack_A) and math; no binary_dest_reuse_tiles_bcast exists. Chain DestReuseBinary has NO bcast param; UnaryBcast is a datacopy from CB (not DEST). So a ROW-bcast DEST-reuse mul is NOT expressible via existing compute-API/chain surface. LLK lib _llk_math_eltwise_binary_with_dest_reuse_ (wormhole llk_math_eltwise_binary.h:507-587) DOES implement COL/ROW/SCALAR bcast for dest reuse, but it is not exposed through the compute API.

compute_fusion example (ttnn/ttnn/operations/examples/compute_fusion) directly measures FPU DEST-reuse fusion of sqrt(x)*b using DestReuseBinary (no bcast) and finds it LOSES vs L1 round-trip (0.82x on the combine step; master.md:82-99). No example fuses a COL-bcast and a ROW-bcast mul into one DST window. Guidance: fuse through DEST only when the next consumer is SFPU; for an FPU binary, pack intermediate to L1.
